name: video-timeline
title: VideoTimeline
description: A video editor's timeline on UI SDK: clips are spans (createSpans) you drag along a track, among a magnetic track's clips (which make room) or to another track, with trim handles on both edges, frame-accurate edits snapping to edges and the playhead, keyboard moves and trims with one Tab stop for the clips and announcements; a ruler that is UI SDK's Slider for the playhead; lane headers (hide, mute, lock), which fold into a menu in a compact container; pinch or ⌘-wheel zoom and drops from a media library. value / onValueChange(value, details) once per gesture or key, so each edit is one undo step.
